title: RESEARCHQA: Evaluating Scholarly Question Answering at Scale Across 75 Fields with Survey-Mined Questions and Rubrics

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the Coverage % metric of generated answers with and without a 250-word length constraint to determine if the recall-based metric artificially favors models that generate longer responses.
Examining if systems unfairly gain higher Coverage % by relying on sources published after the instructed knowledge cut-off date (the distilled survey article's publication year).
Prompting the LLM-as-a-Judge with both possible answer orderings during pairwise preference evaluation to reduce the model's bias toward the first or second presented option.
